description: Requires the account session, current X-Organization-Id and CSRF for writes. Start a TLS review of the saved HTTPS origin using current domain monitoring rights. At most three starts per account and UTC day, one per site. A repeated request reuses today's review. Do not claim complete safety from a partial result. One review per account, organization, origin and UTC day. Starting requires current domain monitoring rights. The account has three starts per UTC day. Retries return the same review. The scanner samples one public IP, with three stages and a 170-second deadline. Partial results do not establish safety. GET never starts a scan. The shared realtime channel reports stage changes. Reports expire after 26 hours.
